meta.description: [PT] Fullstack developer, technology enthusiast and lover of the open-source world.

about.heading: [PT] About Me
about.paragraph1: [PT] Hello, I'm Romullo, {age} years old, brazilian, christian, lover of technology and the open-source world. I graduated in Systems Analysis and Development and currently work as a Software Developer at <softplan>Softplan</softplan>.
about.paragraph2: [PT] Today with the constant updating in the technology world, I dedicate most of my time studying and keeping up to date with the best languages, tools and practices for the development of quality software.
about.paragraph3: [PT] My main hobby is programming! I spend a lot of time contributing to open-source projects on <github>Github</github> and in my spare time I like watching <animes>animes</animes>, series or listening lo-fi.

skills.heading: [PT] Skills
skills.paragraph1: [PT] In these 5 years of walking as a developer and with my curiosity to unravel things, I was able to get a lot experience in various technologies in the Android world, Linux, Desktop and Web.
skills.paragraph2: [PT] Currently, most of the time, I'm working on Web development with Typescript, Nodejs, ReactJs, NestJs and studying DevOps and some tools like Docker, Ansible, Vagrant and Terraform.

openSource.heading: [PT] Open Source
openSource.paragraph1: [PT] The open-source world is a wonderful thing! it's a place where we makes it possible to develop our skills, share knowledge and evolve together with the community.
